comment: alice challenges bob to gomoku moving first, so she plays black; bob accepts, and black wins with five in a row on row 8.
Cells are a column letter then a row number, sent as text; legal_cells is the viewer's own.
A taken cell is an illegal_action, and the game does not move on.
So is a cell off the board: the catalogue pattern is the one the server parses with.
